title: Reports build identity
responsibility: Calculates and caches the identity of the compiled reports server or identifies a development instance.

inputs.name: reportBuildIdentity.directory
inputs.description: Optional build directory, defaulting to the nearest compiled server directory found within six ancestor checks of the running module.

outputs.name: reportBuildIdentity
outputs.description: Cached digest of regular files and relative names in the chosen directory. Returns harness-reports-development when no directory exists or no regular files are found.
